## Terraform Provider for SAP Integration Suite v0.7.1

### Overview

0.7.1 is a patch release of 0.7.0. It rebuilds the provider with Go 1.27.2
and `golang.org/x/net` 0.60.0, which fix known vulnerabilities in the Go
standard library and in `x/net`. The provider's behavior, schema and state
do not change.

### Fixed

0.7.0 was built with Go 1.27.1 and `golang.org/x/net` 0.59.0. `govulncheck`
reports that the provider reaches code with these vulnerabilities, for
example through the plugin server that Terraform talks to:

- GO-2026-6603 (CVE-2026-78659): HTTP/2 server memory exhaustion due to
  Trailer headers in `net/http`.
- GO-2026-6605 (CVE-2026-56866): HTTP/1 client connection desynchronization
  after a CONNECT rejection in `net/http`.
- GO-2026-6607 (CVE-2026-97031): malformed ECH outer extension references
  accepted by `crypto/tls`.
- GO-2026-6608 (CVE-2026-94440): memory limit bypass when parsing MIME
  headers in `net/textproto` and `mime/multipart`.
- GO-2026-6610 (CVE-2026-78660): HTTP/2 transport accepts malformed
  framing-related headers in `net/http`.
- GO-2026-6611 (CVE-2026-78669): excessive CPU consumption from repeated
  initial window changes in `net/http`.
- GO-2026-6612 (CVE-2026-78663): double flow control refund on HTTP/2 server
  streams in `net/http`.
- GO-2026-6613 (CVE-2026-94439): HTTP/1 server connection desynchronization
  after a 2xx CONNECT response in `net/http`.
- GO-2026-6617 (CVE-2026-97032): HTTP/2 server crash due to an HPACK encoder
  race in `net/http`.

With Go 1.27.2 and `x/net` 0.60.0, `govulncheck` finds none of them.

### Upgrade guidance

- Nothing to change in configurations; no schema change and no state
  migration.
- Run `terraform init -upgrade`. A version constraint of `~> 0.7.0` already
  allows 0.7.1.

### Compatibility

- Terraform 1.5 or later; 1.11 or later for resources with write-only
  attributes (`*_wo`).
- Terraform plugin protocol 6.
